Q8080.reason: Article 1 of the 1933 Montevideo Convention lists a permanent population, defined territory, government, and capacity to enter into relations with other states as the criteria of statehood.

Q8086.reason: Anorexia and persistent nausea in an elderly patient on digoxin are classic for digoxin toxicity, so a serum digoxin level is the most appropriate initial study.

Q8089.reason: Pulmonary surfactant lowers alveolar surface tension so alveoli stay open at end-expiration, allowing gas exchange; deficiency causes collapse in NRDS.
